profile: iBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to develop antibody therapeutics for obesity, cardiometabolic, and cardiopulmonary diseases. Its pipeline includes a clinical-stage long-acting myostatin antibody and preclinical candidates, including antibodies targeting Activin E and a myostatin–Activin A bispecific antibody. The company conducts discovery and development work at its research laboratory in San Diego.
